risk_note: RV2 (linking/**, order attribution and user authorization). Taobao open issues a Baichuan sdk step: openByUrl with our promotion link (no pid / relation_id) when the user has a usable one, else openByCode with the scene's active pid and the snapshot user's active relation_id, only when the pid belongs to the binding's union account (otherwise 50301 with an alert). Authorization sits in the conversion port's optional hook (50301 -> scene pid -> 30153 / 30101 / 30102 -> requote): 30101 / 30102 carry auth_url, state (link_id = the served link) and auth_methods through the shared state issuer; site authorization judged on the account in use, unavailable -> auth_unavailable even with no_rebate (BR-ID-24); someone else's share link whose sharer is not active -> 30102 + sharer_auth_invalid without a state; no_rebate with a blocked binding records binding_blocked server-side. The jump cache keeps its key and tags each entry with the binding account, relation_id and the selected pid and its account (normal read, 50303 fallback and single-flight all compare); cached Baichuan steps are validated. Taobao adapter link APIs are never called. Written by hand.
